title: henckelia incana
intro: Henckelia incana, commonly known as the fragrant Himalayan toad plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. It is native to the Himalayas and parts of Southeast Asia, where it grows in shaded, humid areas. The health benefits of Henckelia incana include its use as a natural remedy for various ailments, such as fever reduction, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Henckelia incana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
